FlowDefinitionData.description:
A {@link FlowDefinition} as models and configuration hold it

The statements are recursive: describing them in a JSON schema makes the schema generator explode, so they are
plain JSON there. {@link validateExpr } checks untrusted expressions.

params.description: Names of the flow parameters, in order

version.description: {@link flowVersion} of the definition, computed when missing

TaskOptions.description: Options of a task, and defaults of a flow

delay.description: Delay before the first retry (Duration syntax)

timeout.description: Maximum duration of one attempt (Duration syntax)

useSystem.description: Run the task as the system instead of the launcher

concurrency.description: Maximum number of tasks running at once on this replica

leaseDuration.description: Lease of a claimed task (ms), renewed while it runs

maxContextSize.description: Maximum size of the journal and input of an instance (bytes of JSON)

pollInterval.description: Interval between two polls of the worker (ms)

worker.description: Run the worker loop on this replica
